This serum really surprised me. I tend to be wary of skincare products that are hyper-viral and trendy on the internet since they seem to be gimmicky. However, I was on the hunt for a new peptide serum after running out of a high-end peptide serum that was running me $80 a bottle. The claims seemed similar and the medicube was at a much more affordable price point, so I figured there's be no risk in trying it out. I fell in love with this serum right away! I have very dry skin so I looove serums that aren't too watery and have substance, and the jelly-like texture of this serum is perfect. It's not too heavy or greasy, but just thick enough that it feels hydrating on the skin. After using my first bottle, I noticed a few changes that I'm really happy with. Due to my dry skin, I often struggle with dullness and uneven tone. Additionally, my skin is dry and sensitive to the point that my skin barrier is prone to damage. The barrier weakness is compounded by the fact that I am on a prescription retinoid, so I try to prevent that by using super hydrating serums and creams. I have definitely noticed a positive change in both my skin barrier and tone after using my first bottle- my skin is plumped, soft, and glowy, my texture and tone are so much more even, and I no longer wake up in the morning with bone-dry, itchy, tight skin despite using heavy creams and occlusives at night. In all honesty, this serum was much more effective than the high-end serum that is 4x more expensive! I
